Built-in ImageGen edit, 2 November 2026. Input: orun-eclipse-warden.png.
Final project file: orun-rig-v1.png (2172x724, native alpha).
The tool's atlas did not follow equal-third registration; the renderer uses measured transparent gutters at x=854 and 1484. No generated alpha was replaced or geometrically approximated. This is an articulated 2D asset, not a 3D model or video.

Initial prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: THREE-part transparent character texture atlas for articulated 2D animation in an existing premium painted fantasy card game. Edit supplied Orun, the Eclipse Warden. Preserve EXACT snowy owl identity, bright gold eyes, face shape, feathers, elaborate antique brass and midnight-blue armor, blue cloth, crescent/star engravings. ONE wide 3:1 image, THREE equal square cells side by side, no labels, no words, no grid, no checkerboard. Genuine native transparent alpha. LEFT CELL: the owl's head, feathered torso, armored shoulders, belted waist and flowing blue lower robes, with NO circular eclipse halo and NO blue circular background disc. Remove the big round shield on viewer RIGHT AND remove the reaching wing/forearm and clawed hand on viewer LEFT; repair underlying armor/cloth/feathers cleanly. Keep both shoulder sockets natural and complete, no holes. MIDDLE CELL: ONLY the ornate round crescent-and-star shield from viewer RIGHT, full face of the shield, brass rim, blue material and holding forearm just behind its left edge; no head, no torso, no other hand, no circular sky halo. RIGHT CELL: ONLY the reaching feathered wing/forearm and black clawed open hand from viewer LEFT, in the same foreshortened offering gesture, isolated naturally at its upper-arm socket. No shield, no body, no head. All parts individually fully visible inside their cell with ten percent clear padding. Maintain precise painted detail and original appearance. Minimal wispy pale-blue magic at organic feather/cloth edges is allowed, but do not paint a halo, ground, UI, frame, text or scenery. Parts must overlap cleanly when composited.

Layout correction prompt used for the final file:
Precise production atlas layout correction ONLY. Keep these three existing painted owl-character parts exactly as designed. The previous image has the body too wide and crossing the first third boundary. Fix by scaling and repositioning all three separate parts so they each fit ENTIRELY inside their own equal square cell. Output a 3:1 wide canvas with three equal square cells. LEFT THIRD: entire owl torso/head/robes, reduced scale enough to fit fully within the left third with 10% blank transparent padding on EVERY side. CENTER THIRD: entire crescent-star shield and its little rear forearm, reduced scale and centered fully inside center third with 10% padding. RIGHT THIRD: entire reaching feathered arm/claws, centered and fully inside right third with 10% padding. NOTHING may cross a cell boundary. Leave a visibly wide transparent gutter between each part. Every part complete, no cropping, no touching outer edges. NO other changes, no new art, no halo, no labels, no guide lines. Genuine transparent alpha background. All three cell borders remain invisible.
